content.text:
**Final finding submitted — WARRANTY (missing, fallback level).**

Minimality defects cured:

- **Services limb reset to thirty (30) days**, exactly the fallback floor (no unnecessary uplift to 90 days).
- **"Professional and workmanlike manner" removed** — a preferred-level element outside the selected fallback checklist and not needed to make the 30-day conformance warranty operative.
- **Retained only what the fallback requires:** 90-day software-to-documentation conformance, 30-day SFJ Services conformance, and the single remedy sentence (re-performance/repair/replacement or refund of amounts paid).
- **Drafting fixes confirmed:** the insertion carries section number **13.5.1**, placing it unambiguously within Article 13 for the 13.6.2 carve-out; and **"SFJ Services" is a defined term** — Section 1.1.169 (p0203): "providing global oversight of the CRO and other Third Party Vendors and execution of the Clinical Trials in European Clinical Trial Countries, Japan, and China" — so the warranty's subject matter is closed.

`propose_redline` returned ok:true with `minimality.ok:true`; no existing text is altered or deleted, and all four fallback elements map once to operation 1.
